fact: The Ministry's 2023/24 programme-based budget lists upgrading LAVIMS as a key challenge and funds LAVIMS 2.0 Phase 1 (Rs 30 million in 2023/24) and a Digital State Land Register, to develop a digital geospatial platform for land transfer, ownership and registration.
title: Strategic Overview, Ministry of Housing and Land Use Planning, Programme-Based Budget 2023/24
publisher: Ministry of Finance, Economic Planning and Development
